newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - WMX Tech buy repeated - source.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - WMX Tech buy repeated - source.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Leone Young reiterated buy rating on WMX Technologies Inc, according to a Smith Barney source.
-- Young believes management is "likely to hasten the pace at which it repurchases shares," divests non-core assets, and refocuses on core, high-margin solid waste business, source said.
-- believes moves could come as early as the end of the year, according to source.
-- Young believes that large shareholders "have gotten increasingly impatient with the pace of strategic change" in the company," and "the message has gotten through to management."
-- kept earnings estimates of $1.83 per share for 1996, and $2.05 for 1997.
